newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-JUVENTUS INSTALLED AS NEW CUP FAVOURITES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS INSTALLED AS NEW CUP FAVOURITES.

text.p: Reigning European champions Juventus were installed as the new favourites to win this season's European Cup by British bookmakers Ladbrokes on Wednesday.
Juventus were quoted as 9-4 favourites to win the trophy for a second successive season following their 1-1 draw at Rapid Vienna and Milan's shock 2-1 defeat at Gothenburg.
Milan, who started the day as 7-4 favourites moved out to 11-4 in the betting.
Manchester United moved ahead of Borussia Dortmund as third favourites at 5-1 following their 2-0 win at Fenerbahce.
Dortmund, who won 1-0 at Atletico Madrid remained at 6-1.
Widzew Lodz, who lost their third successive match on Wednesday, are the 1000-1 outsiders.
